title: Add public all-PDFs feed page aggregating uploads from all accounts

requirements.text: Create a new page at '/feed' (or '/all') that displays all PDFs uploaded by all users/accounts in a single, publicly accessible feed. Each entry should show the PDF title, uploader's principal (truncated for readability), upload date, and an 'Open' button that navigates to the existing viewer at /view/<shareId>. The page must be accessible without authentication, using the existing anonymous-compatible listPdfs() backend call. Sort entries by upload timestamp descending (newest first).

quotes: Make a page where all pdf from all accounts go

acceptanceCriteria: A new route '/feed' (or '/all') renders the all-PDFs page without requiring login.
All PDFs from all uploaders are listed, fetched via the existing listPdfs() query hook.
Each card displays: PDF title, uploader principal (truncated), upload date, and an 'Open' button.
Clicking 'Open' navigates to /view/<shareId> for the correct PDF.
Entries are sorted newest-first by upload timestamp.
The page is linked from the site header/navigation.
The page matches the existing dark navy and amber visual theme (card layout, shadows, hover transitions).

requirements.text: Add a 'Feed' navigation link in the site header (Header.tsx) that routes to the new all-PDFs feed page. The link should follow the same active-route highlighting pattern used by the existing Gallery, Upload, and Dashboard nav links.

quotes: Make a page where all pdf from all accounts go

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Feed' link appears in the top navigation bar alongside existing links.
The link routes to the new feed page.
The link is highlighted/active when the user is on the feed page.
No other navigation links are changed or removed.

requirements.text: Register the new feed page route in App.tsx (TanStack Router) so that navigating to '/feed' renders the new FeedPage component. Ensure the route does not require authentication and does not conflict with existing routes.

quotes: Make a page where all pdf from all accounts go

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating directly to '/feed' renders the FeedPage without a 404 or redirect.
The route is public (no auth guard).
All existing routes (/, /upload, /dashboard, /view/:shareId) continue to work unchanged.

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
Reuse the existing listPdfs() React Query hook from useQueries.ts — do not create a new backend function.
Do not alter the existing Gallery page (GalleryPage.tsx) or its route.
nonGoals: Adding per-user profile pages or filtering the feed by a specific user.
Adding pagination or infinite scroll (a flat list is acceptable for now).
Any backend changes — the existing listPdfs() already returns all PDFs from all accounts.
Changing authentication requirements for any existing page.
